sources.title: Harbour Safety Act of Varnholt, version 1 (fictional)
sources.text:
FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Not law and not legal advice.
Harbour Safety Act of Varnholt, version 1

1. Inspections
A vessel longer than 20 metres that berths in a Varnholt harbour must pass a hull inspection at least once every 24 months.

2. Records
The harbour master keeps each inspection record for 3 years after the inspection date.

3. Penalties
Berthing without a valid inspection carries a fine of up to 5,000 credits.

sources.text:

Harbour Safety Act of Varnholt, version 2

1. Inspections
A vessel longer than 20 metres that berths in a Varnholt harbour must pass a hull inspection at least once every 12 months.

2. Records
The harbour master keeps each inspection record for 5 years after the inspection date.

3. Penalties
Berthing without a valid inspection carries a fine of up to 8,000 credits.

sources.text:

Varnholt Harbour Board guidance note on inspection intervals

1. Small vessels
The Harbour Board treats a hull inspection every 18 months as sufficient for vessels between 20 and 30 metres long.

2. Status of this note
This note is guidance. It does not say how it relates to the Harbour Safety Act.

sources.text:
FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Not law and not legal advice.
Quillmouth Port Code, version 1

1. Hull inspections
Every vessel using a Quillmouth port must pass a hull inspection at least once every 6 months.

2. Exemptions
Vessels shorter than 10 metres are exempt from section 1.
